description: Whether one class may read, write, or execute under a mode. Pass the class that applies: on a real system the owner class is used for the owner even when the group bits differ. setuid, setgid and sticky do not grant the bit. Returns JSON with: value, octal, octal4, symbolic, setuid, setgid, sticky, owner. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/permission-check
name: permission_check
title: Permission Check
